set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED='2b833d4dd69483d65c9ae26d8c2afd67f9d3f915'; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch --no-tags origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

seed = Path("app/src/androidTest/java/io/blueeye/UiSmokeSeedInstrumentedTest.kt")
s = seed.read_text()
import_line = "import io.blueeye.core.data.db.entity.DeviceEntity\n"
watch_import = "import io.blueeye.core.data.db.entity.WatchlistEntity\n"
if watch_import not in s:
    assert import_line in s
    s = s.replace(import_line, import_line + watch_import, 1)

old = """                database.deviceDao().upsertAll(devices)
                assertEquals(devices.size, database.deviceDao().getAllDevices().size)
"""
new = """                database.deviceDao().upsertAll(devices)
                devices.take(2).forEach { device ->
                    database.watchlistDao().insert(
                        WatchlistEntity(deviceFingerprint = device.fingerprint),
                    )
                }
                assertEquals(devices.size, database.deviceDao().getAllDevices().size)
                assertEquals(true, database.watchlistDao().isOnWatchlist(devices[0].fingerprint))
                assertEquals(true, database.watchlistDao().isOnWatchlist(devices[1].fingerprint))
"""
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
seed.write_text(s)

h = Path("tools/ui-smoke/run-android-ui-smoke.sh")
t = h.read_text()
old_block = """tap_desc "Menu"
tap_text "Watchlist"
wait_target text "Watchlist"
shot 09-watchlist
if coords text "Signal Hints" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  tap_switch_for_text "Signal Hints"
fi
if coords content-desc "Remove from Watchlist" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  tap_desc "Remove from Watchlist"
fi
shot 10-watchlist-after-controls
"""
new_block = """tap_desc "Menu"
tap_text "Watchlist"
wait_target text "Watchlist"
wait_target text "Walk bag tag"
wait_target text "UI Smoke Watch Two"
wait_target content-desc "Remove from Watchlist"
shot 09-watchlist
tap_switch_for_text "Walk bag tag"
tap_desc "Remove from Watchlist"
wait_target content-desc "Remove from Watchlist"
shot 10-watchlist-after-controls
"""
assert old_block in t
t = t.replace(old_block, new_block, 1)
h.write_text(t)

PY
bash -n "tools/ui-smoke/run-android-ui-smoke.sh"; git diff --check; test "$(git diff --name-only | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = '2'; git diff --name-only | sort > /tmp/ui-smoke-paths; printf '%s\n%s\n' 'app/src/androidTest/java/io/blueeye/UiSmokeSeedInstrumentedTest.kt' 'tools/ui-smoke/run-android-ui-smoke.sh' | sort > /tmp/ui-smoke-expected; diff -u /tmp/ui-smoke-expected /tmp/ui-smoke-paths; ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleDebugAndroidTest; git add "app/src/androidTest/java/io/blueeye/UiSmokeSeedInstrumentedTest.kt" "tools/ui-smoke/run-android-ui-smoke.sh"; git commit -m 'Exercise real watchlist controls in UI smoke'; git push origin HEAD:main; printf 'ui_smoke_watchlist_sha=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
